name: Auth - Register new user
description: Verifies the user registration flow including form validation, successful account creation, and role assignment

planSteps.description: Navigate to /register and verify the registration form is displayed with all fields (name, email, password, confirm password, role selection)
Submit with empty fields and verify form validation error messages appear
Assert that password confirmation mismatch shows validation error
Fill in valid registration data: name='Test User', email='testuser@cermont.com', password='StrongPass123!', confirm password, select role 'operador'
Submit the form and wait for success confirmation
Assert that registration succeeds and user is redirected to /login with success message
